contributions.detail: The PDF is ONE page: the Carr cover only. Form A (page 2 of the printed form) is not present in the document at all, so there is nothing to itemize and no rows can be claimed. sides='none', NOT a zero. Cover line 1 THIS cell is a slashed-zero glyph -> 0 per the zero-glyph ruling; line 2 LAST is written '170 -' (trailing dash = no cents, i.e. 170.00) and is kept verbatim as printed.

expenditures.basis: no schedule page exists in this document
expenditures.detail: Form B is not present in the document (1-page PDF, cover only). The expense figures are the filer's own cover cells: LAST '5476''' (two prime marks = no cents), THIS slashed-zero, CUMULATIVE '5476'. THE CUMULATIVE TERMINAL GLYPH IS BISTABLE 4/6 and reads superficially as '5474' even at 1200 dpi; the filing's own arithmetic settles it as 5476 (see balance_chain). RHODES RULE APPLIED: arithmetic outranks the glyph re-read at any resolution. Recorded as 5476 with the bistability disclosed rather than silently.

gates.balance_chain: CLOSES EXACTLY on the cumulative scope: 2125 (line 1 cum) + 170 (line 2 cum) - 5476 (line 3 cum) = -3181, and cover line 4 CUMULATIVE reads -3181''. This is the arithmetic that proves line 3 cumulative is 5476 and not 5474 (5474 would give -3179). Note a separate filer inconsistency in the LAST-REPORT column: line 4 there reads '3181''' with NO minus sign while the cumulative cell carries one; both retained verbatim, neither corrected.

escalation_note: 1200 dpi crops of the CUMULATIVE column lines 3-4 (x=8200 y=9600 W=1900 H=1900) and of the LAST-REPORT column lines 3-4 (x=3600 y=9600 W=2400 H=1900). The LAST column renders an unambiguous "5476''" with a looped 6 matching this writer's 6 elsewhere; the CUMULATIVE column's terminal glyph is the same looped form but scanned thinner and reads 4-like. Escalation did NOT settle it; the balance-chain arithmetic did.
